bug_semantics: Budibase's datasource read APIs returned the stored datasource config to an authenticated caller. The later removeSecrets control only replaced fields declared PASSWORD (and, from May 2026, SENSITIVE_LONGFORM), while MongoDB connectionString and Firestore privateKey remained declared STRING. Consequently GET /api/datasources/:datasourceId, authorized only for TABLE/READ in affected code, returned a live MongoDB URI or Firebase service-account private key in plaintext; the builder-only list/read responses were affected by the same schema/redactor mismatch.
flaw_origin: The complete exploitable path first appears in merge-resolution commit 29b51bc6c2fc8874ab7aa7a0c849ff5f205aec5a: it creates the datasource controller and a TABLE/READ GET /api/datasources/:id route, and find performs database.get(id) followed by ctx.body = datasource with no secret removal. MongoDB's STRING connectionString already existed from fbf501aebc0a4b16e5715e0b4fc875a4998f319b, so 29b51bc6c2fc8874ab7aa7a0c849ff5f205aec5a is the smallest first commit that completed the low-privilege disclosure path. Firebase commit c2d48bebd7100d7949de4555759de543a00b9256 later added privateKey as STRING. Partial-redaction commit b659060beb4246ad943b4660fb06f7a823d12a3d routed reads through removeSecrets but masked only PASSWORD fields, preserving rather than originating the already-exploitable leak.
ai_marker: absent on BIC 29b51bc6c2fc8874ab7aa7a0c849ff5f205aec5a: `git cat-file commit` identifies human author and committer Martin McKeaveney <martin@shogunsystems.co.uk> and contains only the subject `separation of datasources and queries`; there is no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, AI trailer, or bot identity.
evidence: First-party advisory https://github.com/Budibase/budibase/security/advisories/GHSA-6mpp-gfg5-x2vv (referenced by GHSA-95j2-62cr-h4p5) describes plaintext MongoDB connectionString and Firebase privateKey through the datasource read API and declares affected <3.40.0 / patched 3.40.0. In the validated clone, `git show --cc 29b51bc6c2fc8874ab7aa7a0c849ff5f205aec5a -- packages/server/src/api/routes/datasource.js packages/server/src/api/controllers/datasource.js` shows the new TABLE/READ GET /api/datasources/:id and find returning the CouchDB document unchanged. `git rev-parse 29b51b^1 29b51b^2` gives 8e10a4ac7db19e26f0061264f6c5cf962e094013 and 0665a0dcc5b3b92c2061cc4feb38afceba491adc; `git ls-tree -r --name-only` for both parent trees contains neither datasource route nor datasource controller, directly proving parent absence and that the vulnerable code was written in the merge resolution rather than inherited from a member commit. `git show fbf501aebc0a4b16e5715e0b4fc875a4998f319b -- packages/server/src/integrations/mongodb.js` shows connectionString type `string`; `git show c2d48bebd7100d7949de4555759de543a00b9256 -- packages/server/src/integrations/firebase.ts` shows privateKey type DatasourceFieldTypes.STRING. `git show b659060beb4246ad943b4660fb06f7a823d12a3d -- packages/server/src/sdk/app/datasources/datasources.ts packages/server/src/api/controllers/datasource.ts` shows removeSecrets introduced on all datasource responses but conditioned solely on DatasourceFieldType.PASSWORD; `git blame 3.39.19 -L 369,375 -- packages/server/src/api/controllers/datasource.ts` traces the affected find response through removeSecretSingle and back to the 29b51b origin. The minimum closing sequence is b7f03866921f8e8d8b936c949ab6c19698b21954 (MongoDB STRING -> PASSWORD), cc0fd3274b0f36c2510759218eb3616980236f93 (Firebase STRING -> SENSITIVE_LONGFORM), then direct final closure d00ba9e893e85f45047fe4ca481d392564e51e29 (moves single-datasource GET from TABLE/READ authorizedRoutes to builderRoutes). `git diff 3.39.19..3.39.20 --` those three files displays exactly all three changes; tag commits are 3.39.19=2cbae01b8850b218eda58d6edf607b27bdbe37fa (vulnerable), 3.39.20=43e11872d41f3e8a70cc0b3f357d39fdb9c67b92 (contains the complete fix), and 3.40.0=661fe55d609404d073eea86702e0bde7942c3f10 (also fixed). Thus repository tags show the code fix already in 3.39.20, although the published advisory conservatively names 3.40.0 as the patched boundary. `git cat-file commit 29b51bc6c2fc8874ab7aa7a0c849ff5f205aec5a` reproduces the BIC-only marker check.
reasoning: The credential-bearing MongoDB schema predates the standalone datasource API, so fbf501aebc0a4b16e5715e0b4fc875a4998f319b alone is not the complete disclosure path. Commit 29b51bc6c2fc8874ab7aa7a0c849ff5f205aec5a is smaller and causally exact: with MongoDB already present, it first creates an API that a TABLE/READ user can call and returns the entire stored datasource object. Both of its parents lack the route/controller, so this is not a move, refactor, inherited merge member, or release backport; the merge resolution itself is the first writer. Firebase added a second affected secret in 2022. The 2023 redactor was an incomplete mitigation because its field-type allowlist skipped both STRING credentials, and the May 2026 SENSITIVE_LONGFORM extension still skipped fields misdeclared STRING. The three consecutive June 2026 commits finally classify both fields as secret and raise the single-read route to builder access; d00ba9e893e85f45047fe4ca481d392564e51e29 is the direct final commit after which the complete reported path is closed. The BIC commit object has only a human identity and no AI attribution, so later history and fix authorship are irrelevant under the BIC-only rule and the verdict is NOT_AI.
